channel.title: Scaleway incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Scaleway's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: [MGDB] - [fr-par] - Restore Snapshot is broken [investigating]
item.description: The Snapshot Restoration feature is broken. Our team working to fix this situation.

item.title: [Jobs][fr-par] some jobs cannot be started due to internal error [resolved]
[VPCL] - it-mil-1 - Network Incident on going at IT-MIL-1 [resolved]
[NETI] - AMS1/H6/6B52 - Public switch has rebooted [resolved]
item.description: At 03:45 AM CEST on 08/09/2026, the public switch located in AMS1 room H6 rack 6B52 has rebooted. During the reboot, all servers located in this rack have lost public connectivity, all services are now restored.

item.title: [NETI] - DC2/301/D4 - Public switch unavailable [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved, the public switch is now reachable again.

item.title: [NL-AMS] Traces ingestion unavailable [resolved]
item.description: We were unable to ingest some traces from 2026-09-01 22:00:00 to 2026-09-02 11:00:00 Incident is opened and closed retroactively

item.title: [OBJS] - [it-mil] - Elevated error rate - All hive nodes are down [resolved]
[TREM] - Delivery latency [resolved]
item.description: The main problem has been found and resolved. The email in queue may take some minutes to be completely sent.

item.title: [BOOKMYNAME] – Global – .CO TLD Connectivity Issue [resolved]
item.description: From 11:30 AM to 3:30 PM, communication with the .CO TLD was unstable, causing errors in all domain‑related operations

item.title: [LBAS] - [fr-par-1] - Extra delay on Load Balancer configuration/creation [resolved]
[VPC] Network Connectivity issues in pl-waw-3 [monitoring]
item.description: We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.

item.title: [DC3] Public switch reboot in DC3 - Room 4 - Zone 4-5 - Rack A11 [resolved]
[BILL] - Duplicate PDF documents for Scaleway Italia customers [resolved]
[DDBK] - [DC3] - dedibackup unvalaible - 500 error [identified]
item.description: Since August 26th, the dedibackup on DC3 has been unreachable and is returning 500 errors.

item.title: [Elastic Metal] Install issues [resolved]
item.description: The issue should now be fixed. We invite you to retry installing your Elastic Metal server if it is still in an error state.

item.title: Temporary Traffic Loss on partial FR-PAR-2 instances [resolved]
item.description: Outage Timestamps : Start-Time : 13:47 UTC End-Time : 13:56 UTC Due to a production operation on a specific network device. Instances located on the hypervisors connected to this network device have been impacted by a network outage. This outage has impacted all outbound traffic of these instances. Inbound traffic was not impacted.

item.title: [CKPT] [FR/NL/PL] - Cockpit Logs ingestion down [resolved]
item.description: Loki is up on all Regions. Some logs have been lost because too old for replay, we're sorry for the impact.

item.title: [OBJS][AMS][PAR] Increased 5xx errors following the loss of a rack [resolved]
[SEDB] - [fr-par] - Endpoint not displayed correctly in the console [resolved]
[BMNA] - global - epp instability for some TLDs [resolved]
[OBJS] - [pl-waw] - Elevated P99 latencies due to a slow storage pod [resolved]
item.description: As of 7:47 a.m. UTC, latencies have returned to a nominal state.

item.title: [BMNA] - [world] - EPP connection issues with Verisign Registry (.com/.net/.name/.cc) [resolved]
